items.contract: Validation-scale post-load interactions meet 250 ms p95 on the reference machine.
rules: RULE-25 defines fixture cardinality, sampling, p95, and solver exclusion.
items.actorBoundary: Real Chrome with complete target-scale accepted snapshot
items.claim: Measured search, filter, day and selection p95 values are each below 250 ms.

evidence.source: WorkspaceBrowserIT.java:300-378 and final clean verify output
evidence.observation: Fixture asserts 1000 lessons, 100 teachers, 60 classes, 100 rooms, 60 periods; 20 post-load samples give p95 search 69.5, filter 38.8, day 172.6, selection 81.1 ms; solver time excluded.

negativeObligations: Initial snapshot load and solver duration are excluded from interaction samples
counterEvidence: The first selection sample was 458.6 ms and one day sample was 261.7 ms; both are above the target but below-p95 by the declared nearest-rank calculation.

items.contract: Target-scale post-load interactions are measured at p95 separately from solver time.

evidence.source: WorkspaceBrowserIT.java:300-378 and final clean verify output
evidence.observation: Test asserts 1000/100/60/100/60 cardinalities, records 20 samples per interaction, computes ceil(n*.95)-1, asserts all p95 under 250 ms, prints raw samples and solver exclusion.
